speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You have presented with gait and limb ataxia; to begin my evaluation, can you tell me how long you have noticed these symptoms and if they have been getting worse over time?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that description. Since the ataxia seems to be predominantly affecting your right side, has this weakness been present since the beginning, or did it develop gradually over time? Also, do you have any other medical conditions or take any regular medications?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: PML (Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy) secondary to natalizumab therapy in a patient with Crohn's disease.
